comparison: Every one of 437 empty hulls and all 39 raw fields are compared to original pinned desktop EOS. Relative tolerance 1e-10 and absolute 1e-9 allow platform noise; integers, booleans, nulls, units, wire scalar types and identities are exact. All earlier comparators remain required.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed all original PNGs. Empty-hull picker labels, selected hull, Unicode name and action buttons are legible and reachable. Ship/structure and restart views distinguish numeric zero damage from unavailable gun range. Prior library/navigation/equipment views remain legible; long names wrap and rename actions remain above the keyboard. Viewport clipping is normal scrolling, not lost controls.
